newsitem.title: USA: MYR Group says wins $4.8 mln insurance suit.
newsitem.headline: MYR Group says wins $4.8 mln insurance suit.

text.p: MYR Group Inc said Tuesday it won a 12-year-old insurance coverage lawsuit including a $4.8 million decision, but it expects the insurance carrier to appeal.

"We are gratified that the company received a decision in its favor, approximately $4.8 million, in its insurance coverage lawsuit in New York," Charles Brennan, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement. "The company does expect that the carrier will file an appeal of the decision."
MYR Group posted a fourth quarter operating profit of $0.29 per primary share versus $0.27 last year, and an operating profit of $1.15 per primary share for the year versus $1.01 in 1995.

The company reported a fourth quarter loss from discontinued operations of $0.05 a share and a loss for the year of $0.15 a share. It said the losses were related to additional provisions for legal and related expenses associated with the lausuit.
MYR Group said the suit, in Federal Distric Court, was between the company, its insurer and its insurance brokers. The trial was concluded on February 28, 1997.
"The court ruled in favor of the company against its insurer on all issues," the company said. "The court's decision has not been reflected in the company's 1996 financial results."
The company could not be immediately reached to provide additional information.
